A '''battle''' was fought on [[Lubang Minor]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. A [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] gunship carrying a unit of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] was shot down by [[Droid starfighter/Legends|Droid starfighters]], stranding trooper [[Able|BL-1707]] on the planet for more than twenty years.
